S28.01.needs: a text artifact (code, HTML or document); not PDF, DOCX or image
S28.01.note: Source editing is offered only for text artifacts on the latest version; the code audit's line numbers had moved, but the Save and Source controls exist at ArtifactPreview.tsx:2600-2726. The control that starts editing inside the Source view was not confirmed.
steps: Open a text artifact from the chat so it shows in the Artifacts panel.
Click the Source button (title "Source").
Change a line of the text in the editor.
Click Save (title "Save as a new version"). The Save button only appears when the source can be edited.
Look for a new version in the version controls, and check that the edited text is still there after you switch away and back.
S28.01.where: Artifacts panel > Source (icon button, title "Source") > edit the text > Save (title "Save as a new version")

S28.10.note: Code audit says partial: the live preview needs the sandbox origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_SANDBOX_ORIGIN, apps/web/lib/artifact-sandbox.ts:159) set and the sandbox redeployed, per the plan; not verified live.
steps: Generate an HTML artifact in the chat and open it in the Artifacts panel.
Make sure the Preview button (title "Preview") is selected.
Check that the page renders and responds to clicks and typing, as the page itself describes.
S28.10.where: Artifacts panel > Preview (icon button, title "Preview") on an HTML artifact

S28.11.note: Code audit says partial: same sandbox origin dependency as S28.10 (apps/web/lib/artifact-sandbox.ts:159); not verified live.
steps: Generate a React artifact in the chat and open it in the Artifacts panel.
Make sure the Preview button (title "Preview") is selected.
Check that the components render and respond to clicks, as the code describes.
Compare with Expected: components render as a live preview.
S28.11.where: Artifacts panel > Preview (icon button, title "Preview") on a React artifact

S28.16.needs: an artifact that throws at run time
S28.16.note: The error box (pre id error) is written by infrastructure/sandbox/index.html:374 and reportRenderError at infrastructure/sandbox/index.html:920; it shows only the message text, with no recovery control of its own. Recovery depends on Refresh preview (ArtifactPreview.tsx:3542).
steps: Open an artifact whose code throws an error when it runs (for example a React artifact that throws).
Look in the preview area for the red-text message that starts with "Render error:" in a box.
Note that the box has no button; the recovery control is Refresh preview (aria-label "Refresh preview").
S28.16.where: Preview area of the Artifacts panel, when the app throws an error

steps: Open an artifact that shows a preview.
Click the Refresh preview button (circular arrow icon, title "Refresh preview").
Look for the preview to reload and show its content again.
S28.18.where: Artifacts panel > Refresh preview (icon button, title "Refresh preview")

S28.22.needs: an app whose code calls agi.complete
S28.22.note: The brokered call is defined at infrastructure/sandbox/index.html:313 and served by apps/web/app/api/artifacts/runtime/[token]/complete/route.ts; the route's quoted line was not found, so the call path is confirmed by the sandbox file only.
steps: Open an app that calls agi.complete(...) in its code (the generated app itself makes the call).
Click the button or control in the app that triggers the AI call.
Look for the AI reply to appear inside the app; no separate control in the Artifacts panel shows this.
S28.22.where: Inside the app's own code: the agi.complete(prompt, options) call provided by the sandbox runtime

S28.23.needs: an app whose code uses storage
S28.23.note: No user-facing control to configure storage or a database was found in the artifacts panel; the storage routes are apps/web/app/api/artifacts/runtime/[token]/storage/route.ts and apps/web/lib/services/artifact-runtime-service.ts:208. Whether the user can configure it was not confirmed.
steps: Open an app whose code writes a value with storage.set(...).
Reload the preview with Refresh preview (title "Refresh preview").
Look for the value to still be there after the reload, which shows app-local storage works.
S28.23.where: Inside the app's own code: storage.get / storage.set calls provided by the sandbox runtime

S28.24.note: The menu item text is built from the language, so the extension part varies by artifact.
steps: Open a code or text artifact in the Artifacts panel.
Click the Download button (title "Download", aria-label "Download artifact").
Click Download source; the item text ends with the file extension, for example "Download source (.html)".
Open the downloaded file and compare it with the code shown in the Source view.
S28.24.where: Artifacts panel > Download artifact (title "Download") > Download source (.ext)

S28.25.needs: two or more artifacts in one conversation
S28.25.note: The button shows only when there are more than one artifact (ArtifactsPanel.tsx:735); the zip is built in apps/web/features/chat/utils/downloadArtifacts.ts:163.
steps: Create a chat with two or more artifacts so the Artifacts panel shows them.
Click the Download all button (title "Download all artifacts as zip").
Wait for the toast "Preparing artifact download…" to finish.
Open the downloaded artifacts.zip and check that each artifact is inside.

S28.27.note: Whether a Free account can publish was not checked in the code.
steps: Open an artifact in the Artifacts panel and sign in if asked.
Click the Publish button (globe icon, title "Publish"). Its label is visible only on wide panels.
Choose an audience: "Anyone with the link", "Everyone in this workspace" or "Only people you invite".
Wait for the toast "Published · link copied to clipboard" or "Published. Copy the link from the bar below."
Open the link in a private window and compare the page with the artifact.
S28.27.where: Artifacts panel > Publish (globe button, aria-label "Publish artifact to a public link")

S28.30.needs: an artifact with at least two versions
S28.30.note: A second route exists: the more menu item "Restore version N" (ArtifactPreview.tsx:2346) when viewing an older version. The label of the trigger that opens that menu was not confirmed.
steps: Open an artifact that has more than one version.
Click the version counter button (title "Version history") to open the list.
Click Restore beside an older version, then Restore in the confirmation "Restore version N?".
Check that the content matches the older version and that a new latest version was added.
S28.30.where: Artifacts panel > Version history (title "Version history") > Restore beside an older version
